description: Source code for a CodeMirror mode implementing Textile markup language syntax highlighting.

methods.name: startNewLine
methods.description: Initializes state at the start of a new line, managing layout modes and list spanning.

methods.name: handlePhraseModifier
methods.description: Handles inline phrase modifiers like bold, italics, links, and special characters.

methods.name: togglePhraseModifier
methods.description: Toggles inline phrase modifiers based on stream context and pattern matching.

methods.name: tokenStyles
methods.description: Determines CSS styles for current token based on state.

methods.name: textileDisabled
methods.description: Checks if textile syntax highlighting is disabled for current state.

methods.name: tokenStylesWith
methods.description: Combines token styles with additional styles if provided.

methods.name: activeStyles
methods.description: Returns array of active styles based on state flags.

methods.name: blankLine
methods.description: Resets state on blank line, preserving spanning layout if applicable.

methods.name: RE
methods.description: Creates or retrieves cached regular expressions for Textile syntax components.

methods.name: createRe
methods.description: Constructs regex patterns for different Textile syntax elements.

methods.name: Modes
methods.description: Defines different parsing modes for Textile syntax elements.
